verdict.rationale: Ollama's first-party docs explicitly list a Python library and a JavaScript library for calling it from your application, with dedicated pages for Python and for JavaScript/TypeScript, layered on its REST API. Evidence is brief headline-level documentation without depth on library features or independent hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: detailed library documentation (install, API coverage, examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of the client libraries.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the runtime from official client libraries in languages like Python or JavaScript
